gaps.sentence: This old house needs doing ___ before winter.
gaps.explanation: do up = repair and decorate a building. (British usage)

gaps.sentence: It took all morning to sort ___ the garage.
gaps.explanation: sort out = organize/put in order, or solve (a problem).

gaps.sentence: The concert tickets sold ___ within an hour.
gaps.explanation: sell out = all tickets/goods are sold.

gaps.sentence: She looks ___ on people who disagree with her.
gaps.explanation: look down on = consider inferior (opposite: look up to).

gaps.sentence: She's been going ___ a difficult time at work.
They've set ___ a new charity for homeless dogs.
The car broke ___ on the motorway.
